title: Local domain-session mailbox reads transiently fail with '409 federation authority changed; refresh enrollment and retry' after a peer reconnects
outcome: A remote peer reconnecting or re-authenticating does not make reads of LOCAL domain-session mailboxes on Central fail. If a federation authority change genuinely invalidates a read, the host refreshes internally and the read either succeeds or returns a typed, actionable refusal. A receipt is issued on the first successful read, not after an extra receiptPending round.
acceptance: unrelated peer re-auth does not fail local domain mailbox reads; genuinely stale authority is safely refreshed or returns a typed actionable refusal
first successful logical read returns its durable receipt without requiring an avoidable extra receiptPending round, preserving exact page/key/idempotency and ownership
focused reconnect/negative tests and Windows/WSL checks pass, clean review pair
